provider_receipt.summary: Review found named security/privacy and contract defects: (1) src/lib.rs:107-124 ingests every Markdown file directly into semantic memory without classifying authority, status, privacy, or review requirements, contrary to docs/human-knowledge-ingestion-contract.md:23-25 and 71-93; (2) src/lib.rs:56-89 does not persist records at all—the constructed record is only serialized and discarded—so the claimed memory integration is ineffective; (3) src/lib.rs:184-192 allows absolute paths and ../ traversal in slash-containing wikilinks, and src/lib.rs:174-175 exposes whether out-of-vault paths exist through backlinks; (4) src/lib.rs:120 uses the note's displayed path as a memory identifier, which can disclose private absolute filesystem paths if persistence is implemented; (5) src/lib.rs:13-25 implements legacy frontmatter incompatible with the active ingestion contract, including numeric confidence instead of low|medium|high and omission of privacy, authority, source_type, owner, review_required, and provenance fields; (6) src/lib.rs:110-114 silently discards traversal errors, allowing incomplete scans to be reported as successful. The durable evidence proves only a clean tracked tree and close-receipt lineage; it does not support functional, security, privacy, or contract-compliance completion. No declared checks were rerun and no files were modified.
